method: Direct visual inspection of four native-size lettered images, four panels at 360px width in the proof sheet, separate 360px panel 2 after punctuation fix, and simulated 3:4 profile thumbnail. Programmatic checks supplement visual observations.

observations.continuity: Woman retains brown bun, ivory knit, green skirt and beige tote across store scenes; milk keeps the blue/ivory package. Jango retains the left handle/pineapple, right hinges, chef hat, mitten hands, apron pocket and mint shoes. At home his seating side changes to preserve setup-before-punchline reading order.
observations.artIntegration: Jango, woman and props share warm contour, opaque fills and paper texture; no pasted character cutout is used. Face/hand expressions differ by scene. Shelf return, empty basket and bowl contact read clearly.
observations.story: Excited 1+1 offer → registered milk quantity discovered → carton returned → existing milk used and giant-bowl joke. Exactly one primary action per panel; illustrated inventory is clearly marked as an example.
observations.framing: Panels 1/3 show Jango hat through shoes; panel 2 is a close view with shoes near the lower edge, consistent with declared close-up framing; panel 4 uses natural table occlusion. No source is stretched.
observations.lettering: Speech balloons remain clear of faces/hands. Dialogue has approximately 24–27px font size at 360px width before font ink proportions. Phone milk/quantity read at 360px. Gaegu lacks U+2026 and U+00B7: ellipsis is visibly composed using three Gaegu period glyphs; series label uses spacing. Canonical dialogue remains unchanged in records.
observations.profileThumbnail: Title and both first-panel dialogue blocks remain readable within simulated 3:4 crop; only peripheral store/cart edge is cropped.
observations.footer: Brand and single action line fit in the last panel ivory band with sufficient contrast; no download promise or fabricated button is depicted.

humanAdoption: Pending. Agent visual review does not replace user SNS adoption.
scope: Promotional illustration only; no application, production API, account, DB, MASTER or publication changes.
